title: An integral degree-three Gersten counterexample

issues.description: The identification of beta_E·[u] with alpha_E ∪ Kummer(u) uses multiplicativity of the motivic-to-K spectral sequence for the mixed integral × mod-5 pairing, including that the induced filtration is compatible with products and that the associated graded pairing equals the cup product. This is cited from Friedlander–Suslin and Suslin rather than proved. It is standard, but it is the one load-bearing external input.
issues.evidence: 'Product compatibility identifies it, under (degree-three-edge), with alpha_E ∪ [u]' cites FriedlanderSuslin Thm 16.2/App. C and Suslin Lemma 3.4/Thm 6.1.

coverage: I read every section of the paper. Checks I did by hand: the affine equation F=(x-1)^5-xy^4+y^5+zeta has constant term -pi and its linear terms lie in m^2 (5x with 5=u·pi^4), so A is regular and pi is in m_A^2. f(t)=(t-1)^5+zeta is Eisenstein, and N_{D/L}(t)=pi. s^5-s+1 is irreducible over F_5 (Artin–Schreier), and Gauss's lemma then gives integrality of C. The special fiber X^5-XY^4+Y^5 is a cone over F_{5^5}-points, so every closed point specializing away from m has residue degree divisible by 5; points at Z=0 are covered. Steinberg relation: {zeta,t}={eta^5,1-eta}=5{eta,1-eta}=0. Lifting through K_3(S)->K_3(D)->K_2(F_5)=0. Motivic spectral sequence bookkeeping: in total degree 3 only (s,j)=(1,2) survives since cd_5=2, and differentials cannot connect nonzero terms. Nonvanishing of the weight-one image alpha_E, checked via the algebraic closure. Projection formula and v_L(N u)=f·v_E(u). Continuity for the coefficient groups, via the 5-term short exact sequence and exact filtered colimits. Lemma 5.1: every point specializing to m lies in every U_h. Localization/pushforward contradiction: lambda=1 at q0 versus lambda=0 at the omitted points. Sanity check: the point x=0, y^5=pi lies in T, has residue degree 1 and norm pi, so it is reciprocity-consistent with the argument and not a counterexample to it.
main_claim: For A=O_{X,m}, where X ⊂ P^2 over Z_5[zeta_5] is (X-Z)^5-XY^4+Y^5+zeta Z^5=0 and m=[0:0:1], A is a 2-dimensional ramified regular local ring and there is c in K_3(A) with c|_{Frac A}=0 and c|_{A[1/pi]} mod 5 ≠ 0. So K_3(A)->K_3(Frac A) is not injective.
sibling_notes: The companion paper is the K5 counterexample (rank 323, no_gap_found). This paper uses an independent route: a Steinberg lift on the divisor y=0 plus a norm-valuation detector. It does not depend logically on the companion.
